subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah@brightlayer.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Hi Sarah — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap + next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Use case summary: customer support automation + semantic search for KB + post-chat reranking for agent assist.
- Models discussed: chat (Redwood-chat-1 / ~gpt-like), embeddings (Redwood-embed-large), reranking (Redwood-rerank-small).
- Open questions we promised to follow up on: per-model token volume split, target unit economics (your $/1M tokens target), and any procurement timing constraints.

Could you confirm the expected monthly token volumes by model and your target budget range? That will let us put together a clean pricing estimate and a draft SOW.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll convert the volumes into a per-model cost estimate (tokens -> $/1M -> monthly run rate).
- Share a simple SOW + token volume workbook for procurement.

Thanks — copying Alex & Rachel for visibility.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in this message
From: Sarah Chen <sarah@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. Below are the rough volumes we see based on current pilot traffic and our roadmap for Q3: 

- Chat generation (customer-facing chat): 80M input+output tokens / month (estimate includes system+user+assistant tokens)
- Embeddings (semantic search + KB indexing): 20M embedding tokens / month (~10M docs * small embed per doc workload)
- Reranking (post-chat candidate scoring): 5M tokens / month

That totals ~105M tokens / month. Our finance/ops target for vendor unit economics is in the $150–$250 per 1M tokens range (we’re trying to get to ~$200/1M). Our current incumbent is around $230/1M after discounts.

Timeline: procurement for initial contract looks like late March; budget owner has signed off on moving forward pending a pricing/coverage comparison and draft SOW. Happy to join a procurement call next week if that helps.

Forwarding a very rough internal workbook as an attachment so you can see where these numbers come from.

Thanks,
Sarah Chen
VP Product, BrightLayer
sarah@brightlayer.com

Attachments: BrightLayer_token_volume_estimates.xlsx (stated in email)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing follow-up

Sarah — great, this is exactly what we needed. Based on your volumes, here is a clean per-model unit economics estimate and an illustrative monthly run rate (numbers rounded):

Pricing assumptions (list price before any contract discount / reserved commit):
- Chat generation: $220 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings: $180 / 1M tokens (embeddings use different unit definitions but we normalize to 1M-token equivalent)
- Rerank: $160 / 1M tokens

Estimated monthly cost (using your volumes):
- Chat (80M): 80 * $220 = $17,600
- Embeddings (20M): 20 * $180 = $3,600
- Rerank (5M): 5 * $160 = $800
- Estimated total monthly run rate: $21, (total) = $21, (please see corrected calc below)

Let me correct that calc (quick math error):
- Chat: $17,600
- Embeddings: $3,600
- Rerank: $800
- Total: $21, (should be $21, - replace with proper math)

Correct total: $17,600 + $3,600 + $800 = $22,000 / month (~$209 / 1M on a blended basis for 105M tokens).

Notes: 
- Your target ~$200/1M is achievable with a modest committed discount (5–10%) and a 12-month reserved capacity commit. For example, a 10% commitment discount across models brings the blended rate to ~$188/1M.
- We can offer a multi-model bundle (chat + embeddings + rerank) with tiered pricing that improves with higher commits.

Next recommended steps:
1) I’ll upload a short draft SOW and the token-volume workbook with the line-item pricing (attached).
2) If you’re comfortable, we can schedule a procurement sync with your finance/ops and our legal/finance to review PO/SOW and discounting structure — suggest Tue or Wed next week.
3) If you want to lock a target blended $/1M, we can sketch a simple commit tier (e.g., 100M/mo equivalent reserve) and run the formal quote.

I’ve attached: BrightLayer_token_volume_estimates.xlsx (your sheet, annotated) and BrightLayer_SOW_v1.pdf (draft SOW).

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: BrightLayer_token_volume_estimates.xlsx, BrightLayer_SOW_v1.pdf
